2608.05642.title: Bayesian Expected Uncertainty Reduction (B-EUR) Model: A Computational Account of What Makes Design Options Worth Trying
2608.05642.paper_summary:
This paper proposes the Bayesian Expected Uncertainty Reduction (B-EUR) model, which formalizes the value of trying a candidate design action as its expected reduction of epistemic uncertainty about action--outcome relations. The model addresses one part of the Uncertainty Driven Action (UDA) model's open question concerning how changes in uncertainty perception determine action selection. We examine two environmental properties: generalizability, or how far knowledge from one trial extends to neighboring candidates, and outcome discriminability, or how clearly differences among outcomes can be distinguished.
  We tested the model through simulations and human experiments using a graph-shape guessing task that isolates learning about action--outcome relations under a limited trial budget. Epistemic value followed an inverted-U-shaped relationship with generalizability and increased with outcome discriminability in the simulations. In the human experiments, the subjective value of trying and enjoyment followed inverted-U-shaped relationships with generalizability, while choice behavior reflected both properties.
  The B-EUR model provides a computational account of candidate-action evaluation within uncertainty-driven design activity and offers implications for constructing prototype sets, framing design problems, and organizing feedback to support informative exploration.
2608.05642.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文提出了貝葉斯預期不確定性減少（B-EUR）模型，該模型將嘗試候選設計行動的價值形式化為其對行動—結果關係的認知不確定性預期減少。該模型解決了不確定性驅動行動（UDA）模型的一個未解問題，即不確定性感知的變化如何決定行動選擇。我們考察了兩個環境特性：可概括性，即一個試驗的知識能延伸到鄰近候選者的程度，以及結果可區分性，即不同結果之間的差異能多清楚地被區分出來。<lb/>我們通過模擬和人類實驗測試了該模型，使用了一個圖形形狀猜測任務，該任務在有限的試驗預算下孤立了對行動—結果關係的學習。在模擬中，認知價值與可概括性呈倒U型關係，並隨著結果可區分性的增加而增加。在人類實驗中，嘗試的主觀價值和享受程度與可概括性呈倒U型關係，而選擇行為反映了這兩個特性。<lb/>B-EUR模型提供了一種在不確定性驅動的設計活動中對候選行動評估的計算解釋，並對構建原型集、框定設計問題和組織反饋以支持信息探索提供了啟示。
